dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fit on the trailing edge, exhibiting a smooth inward curvature from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a distal radius approximately 5-8% of the total fin height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Measured at approximately 48 degrees relative to the horizontal pixel axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-to-width ratio approximately 1.15 based on vertical displacement from base to apex versus horizontal span of the base.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex parabolic curve with a large radius extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short horizontal extension relative to cranial depth; approximately 2:1 length-to-width ratio at the visible rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximately 140-degree obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon curvature meets the dorsal rostrum line.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-green pixel saturation across the subject body with high-intensity white highlights on the dorsal flank; subject silhouette is isolated on a black background.
